title: Document latest icp0 deployment URL and ensure runtime og:url matches deployed origin

requirements.summary: Record the newly generated working https://[canister-id].icp0.io/ deployment URL in-repo as the latest deployment output.
acceptanceCriteria: A new `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` URL is produced for the app and is reachable in an incognito/private window.
Loading the new URL shows the Campus Point Services homepage (no 'Canister ID Not Resolved' / gateway error).
The latest deployment URL is written into `frontend/DEPLOYMENT_OUTPUT.md` (replacing the placeholder `[TO BE FILLED BY DEPLOYMENT SYSTEM]`).

file_operations.description: Replace the `New Public URL` placeholder `[TO BE FILLED BY DEPLOYMENT SYSTEM]` with the newly generated working `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` URL and ensure the 'Latest Deployment' block reflects this as the most recent deployment URL.

requirements.summary: Update the deployed public URL documentation to reflect the new live icp0 canister URL while keeping the previous vanity URL marked deprecated.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/DEPLOYED_PUBLIC_URL.md` contains the new working URL under 'Public URL' and no longer contains the placeholder string.
The deprecated URL `https://campus-point-services.icp0.io/` remains documented as 'Previous URL (deprecated)'.
Any sitemap example in `frontend/DEPLOYED_PUBLIC_URL.md` uses the new URL (e.g., `[NEW_URL]/sitemap.xml`).

file_operations.description: Replace `[NEW URL TO BE GENERATED]` with the newly generated working `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` URL; update status text to indicate it is live/current; keep `https://campus-point-services.icp0.io/` listed under 'Previous URL (deprecated)'; update the sitemap example line to use the same new URL (e.g., `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/sitemap.xml`).

requirements.summary: Update the Google indexing guide to reference the newly deployed icp0 canister URL and its sitemap URL.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/GOOGLE_INDEXING_GUIDE.md` includes the new working URL under 'Your Live Website URL'.
The guide references the sitemap at the new deployment (e.g., `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/sitemap.xml`).

file_operations.description: Populate the 'Your Live Website URL' section with the newly generated working `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` URL and add/adjust wording so the referenced sitemap URL points to `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/sitemap.xml` for that same deployment.

requirements.summary: Set og:url to the deployed origin at runtime on app startup via updateRuntimePublicUrl(), and remove production debug logging from runtimePublicUrl.ts without modifying frontend/src/main.tsx.
acceptanceCriteria: On first app render, the document `meta[property="og:url"]` content is updated to match `window.location.origin + '/'` (e.g., `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/`).
`frontend/src/utils/runtimePublicUrl.ts` no longer logs the runtime URL via `console.log`.
No changes are made to immutable path `frontend/src/main.tsx`.

file_operations.description: Remove the production debug `console.log` and keep the function behavior focused on computing `${window.location.protocol}//${window.location.host}/` (equivalent to `window.location.origin + '/'`) and updating `meta[property="og:url"]` accordingly.

Invoke `updateRuntimePublicUrl()` on app startup (e.g., via a top-level React effect on initial mount) so `og:url` is set to the actual deployed origin at runtime, without changing the immutable `frontend/src/main.tsx`.
